infoCards.title: Quality Control
infoCards.description: Comprehensive quality management for medical device standards.

faqData.question: How does the system ensure regulatory compliance?
faqData.answer: Our system provides comprehensive compliance management for FDA, CE, ISO 13485, and other medical device regulations, including documentation control, validation protocols and audit trail maintenance.

faqData.question: What quality control features are included?
faqData.answer: The system includes advanced quality control with validation protocols, clean room monitoring, sterilization process control and complete device history records with detailed testing documentation.

faqData.question: Can it handle device traceability requirements?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution provides end-to-end traceability from raw materials to finished devices, including UDI compliance, component tracking and complete device history records.
